candidate: Exact BF16 block base-plus-delta packed lm_head GEMV
scope: Qwen3.5-0.8B, lm_head 248320x1024, batch-1 decode, RTX 4060 Laptop SM89
mechanism: Preserve every BF16 sign, exponent, and mantissa bit while storing sign+mantissa in one byte and the block-local exponent delta in four bits. Blocks whose exponent range exceeds 15 use a dense BF16 fallback. The Triton GEMV reconstructs FP32 values in registers before multiplication.

correctness.fresh_stock_caveat: Fresh stock and the accepted frontier select different compiled reduction paths. The two divergent cases therefore do not show lost weight information; the packed and accepted paths are 6/6 token-identical under the same source and compile cache.

storage.runtime_tradeoff: The model ties lm_head to the embedding, so the prototype retains the dense tensor and adds the packed cache. Production integration should pack at load time or manage the tied copy explicitly.

microbenchmark.interpretation: All weights are reconstructed exactly, but a different FP32 reduction schedule can round logits differently. The production gate therefore checks generated tokens, not bit-identical intermediate logits.

production_validation.qualification_protocol: 3 warmups x 10 trials per case per side, six natural prompts, 128 generated tokens

service_integration.integration: Prepack the tied embedding/lm-head weight and JIT-warm the exact kernel from UnquantizedEmbeddingMethod.process_weights_after_loading before CUDA Graph setup.
service_integration.policy: Enable only for active batch 1 when exact BF16 weights with non-stock reduction order are acceptable; stock BF16 otherwise.

rejected_sibling.candidate: Exact 4096-entry BF16 codebook with 12-bit indices and dense fallback blocks
rejected_sibling.decision: REJECT: exact table lookup and 12-bit unpacking more than double lm_head latency despite similar storage.

qualification: A bounded winner for this GPU, model shape, batch size, and deterministic decode suite; not a proof of a global theoretical optimum or broad production SOTA.
reopen_or_production_rules: Measure randomized process order under a locked power mode before claiming production-wide speedup.
Replace the additive runtime packed cache with a checkpoint-native packed representation before enabling on memory-constrained deployments.
Requalify every model shape, GPU architecture, batch size, sampling mode, and vLLM version separately.
Do not report the historical 1.199x frontier gain multiplied by this 1.051x gain; no current experiment measured that product under one controlled state.
